reviews.author: Hemanth Nandyala
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had a wonderful experience at Dr Sheesha ! The service was absolutely outstanding, and everything was excellent from start to finish. reviews.author: Reza Lakhani
reviews.text: Dr. Sheesha never disappoints, but Manisha made this visit special. She really knows the menu and gave us some fantastic recommendations. If you're looking for top-tier hospitality, ask for her. Great vibes and even better service

reviews.author: Resih Wiyanti
reviews.text: Cafe Sesha is a lovely café with a cozy atmosphere, great coffee, and friendly service. The food is fresh and delicious, making it a perfect spot to relax or meet friends. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Azhar Ali Durrani
reviews.text: Really enjoyed my visit to Dr Sheesha Cafe. Great food, amazing sheesha, and a very cozy atmosphere. Huge thanks to Manisha mam for the perfect service and friendly behavior. She was attentive, welcoming, and made sure we had a great time. Highly recommended place!

reviews.author: Mohammed Mudassir Hussain
reviews.text:
A truly brilliant and unforgettable experience at Dr Shisha — from the moment we arrived to the time we left, everything was handled with exceptional care and attention. The hospitality and ambiance were outstanding throughout, creating a space that felt both luxurious and incredibly welcoming.

The atmosphere was warm, relaxing, and beautifully designed, with stylish décor and a comfortable seating arrangement that immediately put us at ease. The music was perfectly curated, enhancing the vibe without ever being overwhelming, making it an ideal place to unwind, socialize, and enjoy the evening.

A special mention goes to Mrs Manisha for her outstanding care, professionalism, and genuinely attentive service. She ensured that every detail was taken care of, checking in regularly and making sure we were comfortable at all times. Her kindness and dedication truly elevated the entire experience and made us feel genuinely valued as guests.

The shisha itself was excellent, smooth, and well-prepared, adding to the overall enjoyment of the visit. Combined with the great service and inviting atmosphere, it created a complete and highly satisfying experience.

reviews.author: Umair Rana
reviews.text:
I recently visited this shisha café and had a great experience. The atmosphere was cozy and relaxing, perfect for spending time with friends. The staff were polite and attentive, making sure everything was just right. The shisha quality was excellent — smooth smoke, rich flavor, and long-lasting. Their mint and double apple mixes were especially good.
The café also had good background music and comfortable seating, which added to the overall vibe. Drinks and snacks were fresh and reasonably priced. Definitely one of the best places in town to unwind after a long day. Highly recommend!
Specially recommend for host Manisha 💕♥️

reviews.author: Mizba Zaveri
reviews.text:
Honestly, the taste and vibe were amazing! These days, they have a great offer: from Monday to Friday until 6 PM, shisha is only AED 19, and on Saturday and Sunday until 6 PM, it’s AED 29.

We started by trying a few shisha flavors and chose the best one to enjoy while watching the IPL match. Then we ordered two starters – the Chicken Tikka and Chicken Dragon – both were absolutely delicious! We paired them with a Passion Mango Smoothie and a Cookie Smoothie.

For the main course, we had Mutton Rogan Josh and a Pizza – both were incredibly tasty. We ended the meal with a Blueberry Cheesecake that was just perfect.

This is definitely a must-visit spot in Dubai!

reviews.author: Titiksha Patel
reviews.text: Everything was perfect—from the sheesha to the food and the service. Special thanks to Mansu for his warm hospitality and excellent customer care. Highly recommend this place❤️

reviews.author: Bansal Tarun
reviews.text:
Dr. Sheesha, Dubai

Dr. Sheesha in Dubai offers a vibrant and laid-back atmosphere perfect for relaxing with friends or enjoying a solo session. The variety of sheesha flavors is impressive, ranging from traditional favorites to unique blends that cater to every palate. The staff is friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable, always ready to help you choose the right flavor or make adjustments.

The ambiance is cozy with a modern Middle Eastern touch—comfortable seating, ambient lighting, and a great playlist set the mood. Their food and beverage menu is also worth exploring, with delicious bites and refreshing mocktails that complement the sheesha experience well.

Whether you're a local or a tourist looking for a chilled-out spot to unwind, Dr. Sheesha is definitely worth a visit. It’s a well-balanced fusion of quality, comfort, and culture.

Rating: 4.5/5

reviews.author: Shweta bhagvatula
reviews.text:
A nice place to have some food and do shisha. Chill place to hangout with friends and family. The do offer a 6 options testing of shishas, you can test and then choose which flavour you would like to go ahead with.

The food is delicious in taste and the presentation of the food is amazing. Se ordered Paneer tikka and Beetroot crispy kababs both the dishes were delicious and the presentation was great too. Tilak has offered good service to us and the shisha specialist was good with the service.

In all the experience was very good. I would recommend this place as a must try place.
